scope_definitions.engine_high_spp: Mean of four per-seed cumulative steady_clock windows ending at highest SPP. Includes earlier checkpoint I/O and scheduling; excludes startup and later shutdown. Not GPU-only.
scope_definitions.pbrt_high_spp: Mean of four independent highest-SPP whole CPU process durations including startup, loading, render, EXR write and exit.
scope_definitions.observed_ratio: Mean medium time divided by mean time of its same-geometry/camera/light vacuum control within the same renderer and timing scope. Ratio of means; per-seed ratios retained separately.
scope_definitions.engine_cohort: One Application process produces four seeds and three cumulative checkpoints each. All twelve outputs are included in process elapsed, but sample accumulation per seed is only to the maximum SPP.
scope_definitions.pbrt_cohort: Sum of twelve separate process durations, four seeds times three freshly rendered SPP levels; not one process and not simultaneous wall makespan.
scope_definitions.cross_renderer: Different estimators, devices, checkpoint work and timing boundaries; neither absolute times nor observed ratios establish relative efficiency/normality.

limitations: CPU reference and analysis work overlapped parts of the campaign; no isolated benchmark was performed.
Large engine post-checkpoint exit tails are included in Application process times but excluded from metadata windows; specific teardown phase is unprofiled.

A nonzero density control changes absorption/scattering work and image statistics. These observations are not a causal measurement of all overhead introduced by the heterogeneous-medium implementation.
Boundary tangency defect and statistical/render-contract status are reported separately; a timing ratio is not validation PASS.
Depth32 jobs are separate tail diagnostics; excluded from these cohort totals and ratios. See engine_depth32_plan.json and reference_depth32_plan.json for their run definitions.

source_guide.snapshot_status: pre-final Stage2 guide snapshot; owner is appending follow-up records. Final publication should use the same guide paths at their final revision, not assume these snapshot hashes are final.
